known_duplicate_rejection: Original coefficient_loads.scalar_m_probe used scalar m(holder.value), broadcasting pointer bits from a stack pointer slot. The new probe and indirect pointer probe diagnose the same Zig 0.15.1 scalar-address staging problem; neither is timed or claimed as a fresh speed hypothesis.
new_form: Eight-byte by-reference [1]u64 aggregate passed with LLVM *m and elementtype([1 x i64]); retains EVEX qword {1to8}. Compare explicit-clobber first; explicit-read differs only by removing the global clobber after the actual read is represented.
excluded_repetitions: No normalization, uniform child order, DFS order, ready-node scheduling, graph/map count, scales, S-boxes, key injection, endpoints, calling convention or dispatch changes.
